sentences.text: Anchigyps was an extinct genus of birds of prey belonging to the family Accipitridae.
It is classified within the subfamily Gypaetinae.
Only two recorded fossil occurrences of this genus are known to science.
Fossils of the only known species, Anchigyps voorhiesi, have been found in the Ash Hollow Formation of Nebraska.
The genus was described by Zhang and colleagues in 2012.
This animal lived during the Late Miocene epoch, with a time range spanning from 12.5 to 9.4 million years ago.
